when.description: Both domain scores are available for relative comparison; neither domain has a validated cut-off.

interpretationRules.template: Compare the two domain averages descriptively. Do not apply a domain cut-off or percentile; the total score remains the primary interpretation index.

when.description: At least two compatible administrations are available.
